mapper.select: SELECT member.memberno, member.membername, member.schoolname, member.contact FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.branchid = #{branchid} AND member.membername = #{membername} AND member.type = 'S'
SELECT member.memberid, member.membername FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.branchid = #{branchid} AND member.memberno = ${memberno} AND member.type = 'S' AND member.classYN = 'Y'
SELECT memberid FROM ttokssaemdb.member WHERE memberid = #{memberid}
SELECT memberid, email FROM ttokssaemdb.member WHERE membername = #{membername} AND contact = #{contact}
mapper.update: UPDATE ttokssaemdb.member SET memberpw = hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')) WHERE memberid = #{memberid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.member ( branchid, memberid, memberpw, type, membername, schoolcode, schoolname, grade, gender, contact, email, marketing, push, regdate ) VALUES ( #{branchid}, #{memberid}, hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')), #{type}, #{membername}, #{schoolcode}, #{schoolname}, #{grade}, #{gender}, #{contact}, #{email}, #{marketing}, #{push}, now() )

INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.member ( branchid, memberid, memberpw, type, membername, schoolcode, schoolname, grade, gender, contact, email, marketing, push, pushtoken, regdate ) VALUES ( #{branchid}, #{memberid}, hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@')), #{type}, #{membername}, #{schoolcode}, #{schoolname}, #{grade}, #{gender}, #{contact}, #{email}, #{marketing}, #{push}, #{pushtoken}, now() )
mapper.select: SELECT member.memberno, member.branchid, member.type, member.membername, member.schoolcode, member.schoolname, member.grade, member.gender, member.contact, member.email, member.marketing, member.push, DATE_FORMAT(member.regdate, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') regdate FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.branchid = #{branchid} AND member.memberid = #{memberid}
SELECT member.os, iFNULL(member.pushtoken, '') pushtoken FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.memberid = #{memberid} AND push = 'Y'
